item.title: Sport and exercise
item.description: Playing sports, keeping fit and watching matches.

children.definition: a game between two teams or players
children.example: We watched the football match on TV.

children.definition: a group of people who play a sport together
to be the best or the first in a game or competition
children.example: Who won the game last night?

children.definition: to not win a game or competition
children.example: We lost 2–1, but we played well.

children.definition: to get a goal or a point in a game
children.example: Aziz scored two goals in the second half.

children.definition: a person who trains a sports team or a player
children.example: Our coach makes us run every morning.

children.definition: a room or building with equipment for doing exercise
children.example: I go to the gym three times a week.

children.definition: physical activity that you do to stay healthy and strong
healthy and strong because you do exercise
children.example: My grandfather is seventy, but he is still very fit.

children.definition: a person who plays a sport or game
children.example: She is the best player in our school team.

children.definition: an event where people try to win
children.example: Malika entered a chess competition in Samarkand.

children.definition: a large place with seats all around a field, where people watch sport
children.example: The stadium was full for the final.
